verified_facts.text: The Inn at Little Washington was founded in 1978 in a former garage in a tiny Virginia town.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Inn at Little Washington, once a humble garage in a tiny Virginia town, has transformed into a world-renowned culinary destination since its founding in 1978.

verified_facts.text: The guest rooms and suites were created by Joyce Evans, a London stage and set designer.
verified_facts.excerpt: guest rooms and suites are sumptuous hideaways created by Joyce Evans, a London stage and set designer

verified_facts.text: The grounds include a walled garden with a fountain and a pavilion overlooking the mountains, where guests can enjoy breakfast.
verified_facts.excerpt: A delightful walled garden with a burbling fountain or a serene pavilion overlooking the mountains are inviting places for “temporary residents” to enjoy breakfast

verified_facts.text: Guests can stay in village cottages meant to give the feeling of being residents of the village past.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spending time in these cottages gives our visitors the feeling of being residents of the village past.

verified_facts.text: The Inn has a Grecian-inspired pool with private cabanas and poolside food from Patty O's Cafe.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind in effortless luxury at our Grecian-inspired pool, where private cabanas, attentive service, and poolside delights from Patty O’s Café

verified_facts.text: A golf cart tour shows guests the landscape that surrounds the Inn.
verified_facts.excerpt: This intimate golf cart tour reveals the beauty, stories, and thoughtful care woven into the living landscape that surrounds the Inn.

verified_facts.text: In the Goose Walk, Farmer Andy leads a parade of American Buff geese down Middle Street while playing a soprano saxophone.
verified_facts.excerpt: Farmer Andy Thewlis, accompanied by his trusty sidekick Alayna, leads our own little march down Middle Street: Andy serenading the street with his vintage soprano saxophone

verified_facts.text: Master of Scotch Jeff LaBelle leads intimate Scotch tastings exploring rare bottles.
verified_facts.excerpt: An intimate Scotch tasting led by Master of Scotch Jeff LaBelle, exploring rare bottles, distillery traditions, and the craft behind every remarkable dram.

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a picnic to enjoy amid the scenic overlooks, meadows, trails and country roads around Little Washington.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy it at your own pace amid the scenic overlooks, quiet meadows, sun-dappled trails, and winding country roads that make Little Washington so unforgettable.

verified_facts.text: Many hiking trails near the Inn can be reached in Shenandoah National Park via Skyline Drive.
verified_facts.excerpt: Most can be easily found in the Shenandoah Park by accessing Skyline Drive.

verified_facts.text: The Inn is in the foothills of the Blue Ridge Mountains.

verified_facts.text: Guests can dine in the main Dining Room one evening and at the more casual Patty O's Cafe the next.
verified_facts.excerpt: then relax with a casual dinner at Patty O’s Café the next

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the property spans 24 acres with mountain views, trails, a farm and a chicken coop with a crystal chandelier.
verified_facts.excerpt: It spans 24 acres and is accented by mountain views, trails, a farm—even a chicken coop with a crystal chandelier.

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the Monkey Room, where paintings of monkeys line the walls while guests sip cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: head to the Monkey Room, where paintings of the primates tease from the walls while you sip a cocktail

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the Inn has rooms and two-story suites, many with balconies and garden views.
verified_facts.excerpt: both feature rooms and two-story suites, many with balconies and garden views

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler reports that doormen greet guests by name at the entry.
verified_facts.excerpt: Doormen greet you by name at the entry.

verified_facts.text: Little Washington, Virginia, has specialty shops with fine art, antiques and gourmet treats.
verified_facts.excerpt: Little Washington, Virginia, offers a variety of specialty shops featuring fine art, antiques, and gourmet treats.

verified_facts.text: The Inn is in the heart of Virginia's wine country, surrounded by vineyards and wineries.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled in the heart of Virginia's wine country, The Inn at Little Washington is surrounded by a tapestry of esteemed vineyards and wineries

verified_facts.text: Lead florist Sarah Parrish runs a hands-on floral workshop.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join lead florist Sarah Parrish for a relaxed, hands-on workshop where you’ll learn the secrets behind The Inn’s signature floral style

verified_facts.text: The farm micro safari runs Wednesday through Sunday, weather permitting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join Sharron Wednesday–Sunday at 4:45 PM (weather permitting) for what we like to call a micro safari right here at The Inn.

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the Kitchen Tables sit in the kitchen, whose decor was inspired by the dairy room at Windsor Castle.
verified_facts.excerpt: The decor was inspired by the dairy room at Windsor Castle, with handpainted blue and white Portuguese tiles, a bay window looking out on the garden

verified_facts.text: Afternoon Tea is offered at the Inn.
verified_facts.excerpt: Afternoon Tea at The Inn at Little Washington is a ritual as much as it is an experience
